queries: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), o AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, above_overall_avg, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q

assumptions.assumption: 'Above-average' means the status's average modindex exceeds the overall average modindex across all signals with a non-null modindex (a signal-level average, not an average of status averages).
Signals with NULL rfistat form their own group, shown with a NULL status; it is included if it qualifies.
'How far above average' is the status average minus the overall average; the last column is the status average minus the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages (unweighted mean of those averages).

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-status averages, not the signal-level overall average.
